data.name: Mu'Izz
data.gender_notes: Mu'Izz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mu'Izz is an Arabic name that means 'the one who glorifies' or 'the one who elevates'. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'azza' which means 'to glorify' or 'to honor'. The name Mu'Izz carries the meaning “Glorifier” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mu'Izz usually hope their child will grow to embody glorifier and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One of the 99 names of Allah, Al-Mu'izz (المؤز) means 'the one who gives honor and glory'.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mu'Izz total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
